name: Afflictions Of The Wicked The
overview: Scripture reveals that the afflictions of the wicked serve a divine purpose, as God sends plagues and troubles upon them to demonstrate His unmatched sovereignty and power, as seen in the judgments upon Pharaoh and the Egyptians. Despite these judgments, such afflictions often fail to produce true fear or repentance, evidenced by Pharaoh's hardened heart and persistent unbelief. These afflictions also glorify God by manifesting His justice and might, while simultaneously serving as a warning and example to others.
